item.title: Shinozada’s 163 powers Afghanistan U-19 into ICC WC semis
item.description: Afghanistan U-19 produced a commanding all-round performance to defeat Ireland U-19 and book their place in the semi-finals of the ICC Men’s U-19 Cricket World Cup.

item.title: Thousands rally in Minnesota, across US against ICE
item.description: Thousands of protesters took to the streets in Minneapolis on Friday as students across the United States staged walkouts and rallies demanding the withdrawal of federal immigration agents from Minnesota following the fatal shootings of two US citizens.

item.title: 3 ‘drug traffickers’ killed in clash with Tajik forces
item.description: Tajikistani authorities have reported that three “drug traffickers” crossing from Afghanistan into their country were killed during a clash with border forces.

item.title: Pakistan prepares to extend CPEC to Afghanistan
item.description: Pakistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs has informed the Senate Standing Committee on Foreign Affairs that preparations are underway to extend the China–Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) to Afghanistan and to revive the Pakistan–China–Afghanistan trilateral framework.

item.title: Afghanistan futsal team secures top spot in Asian cup group stage
item.description: The Afghanistan national futsal team has emerged as the standout team of the 2026 Asian Cup after the second round of group stage matches, finishing with six points, 10 goals scored and no goals conceded.
